hook.say: Turkey against the world, but this time we count people. Who has more? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which has more people: Türkiye or UK?
questions.say: Which has more people: Turkey or the U K?
questions.fact: Türkiye: about 88 million people. UK: about 70 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It has about eighty-eight million people. The United Kingdom has about seventy million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Türkiye or Mexico?
questions.say: Which has more people: Turkey or Mexico?
questions.fact: Mexico has about 133 million people, Türkiye about 88 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Mexico! It has about one hundred and thirty-three million people. Turkey has about eighty-eight million.

questions.q: Which has the most people: Türkiye, Canada or Australia?
questions.say: Which has the most people: Turkey, Canada or Australia?
questions.fact: Türkiye has more people than Canada and Australia combined (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It has more people than Canada and Australia combined.

questions.q: Which has more people: Türkiye or Vietnam?
questions.say: Which has more people: Turkey or Vietnam?
questions.fact: Vietnam has about 102 million people, Türkiye about 88 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Vietnam! It has about one hundred and two million people. Turkey has about eighty-eight million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Türkiye or Ethiopia?
questions.say: Which has more people: Turkey or Ethiopia?
questions.fact: Ethiopia: about 139 million people. Türkiye: about 88 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Ethiopia! It has about one hundred and thirty-nine million people. Turkey has about eighty-eight million.
